IGUI_FHC_Tracking_MapMarkers: Show animals on the world map

IGUI_FHC_Server_NotAdmin: You need admin or moderator access.
IGUI_FHC_Server_AdminDisabled: Admin population control is disabled in sandbox.
IGUI_FHC_Guide_Open_1: Press H or use the on-screen Hunter Hub button.
IGUI_FHC_Guide_Open_2: Most mod actions are launched from this hub instead of vanilla crafting.
IGUI_FHC_Guide_Field_1: Right-click animal carcasses or use the Field Dress tab.
IGUI_FHC_Guide_Field_2: Multiplayer item outputs are validated on the server.

IGUI_FHC_Guide_Bushcraft_2: Hover or click a recipe to see exact missing ingredients.
IGUI_FHC_Guide_Scents_1: Craft animal scent lures with cologne and matching animal meat.

IGUI_FHC_Guide_Tracking_1: Enable yellow outlines, the nearby HUD, or map markers from the Tracking tab.

IGUI_FHC_Guide_Server_1: Admins and moderators can request an animal census.
IGUI_FHC_Guide_Server_2: Server-side actions validate item creation, removal, field dressing, hub crafting, and scents.
